### Saul’s Final Rejection
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/sauls-final-rejection
Passage: 1 Samuel 28:19
Points:
- Saul's repeated disobedience culminated in desperation when God refused to speak to him before battle.
- Consulting a medium directly violated Scripture's clear prohibitions against sorcery and the occult.
- God permitted Samuel to speak not to endorse necromancy, but to pronounce judgment upon the king.
- Playing with forbidden dark arts invites grave spiritual danger and guarantees ruin.

### Day 37: 1 Samuel 28:8–19
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-37-1-samuel-28-819.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 28:8
Points:
- Saul compromised by seeking the very occult practices he had previously expelled from Israel.
- As a person's reverence for God shrinks, the desires of the flesh take over and revive old sins.
- Believers often backslide by slipping back into compromises they had once forsaken.
- Knowing death is near can serve as a merciful warning prompting a rebel to beg for mercy.

### Bible Pathway - April 10
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-april-10-2013.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 28:7
Points:
- Saul turned to a demonically empowered medium instead of repenting and seeking God's face.
- Unconfessed sin pollutes clear thinking and erects a wall between an individual and God.
- True devotion requires wholehearted obedience rather than attempting to sit on the fence.
- Christians should follow God's Word and Spirit instead of pursuing substitute guides.

### A Wicked Sorceress: The Story of the Medium of Endor
Author: Ann Spangler
Site: Bible Gateway Blog
URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/blog/2015/09/a-wicked-sorceress-the-story-of-the-medium-of-endor/
Passage: 1 Samuel 28:3-25
Points:
- Saul's persistent self-will and rejection of God left him isolated, fearful, and abandoned to divine silence.
- In his desperation, the king hypocritically resorted to the dark spiritual practices he had outlawed.
- God intercepted the medium's conjuring to deliver a terrifying message of imminent defeat and death.
- Saul's tragic collapse warns against the peril of relying on oneself rather than trusting the Lord.
